ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-contrast white markings; approximately 10-15% high-intensity pixel coverage against an 85-90% low-intensity background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white markings are distributed across the entire ventral surface. Distinct clusters of ring-shaped white rosettes are concentrated in the lower central regions of both lobes, while thin linear white streaks are dispersed semi-randomly across the upper and outer lobe areas.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 110-120 degrees; deep incision relative to the surrounding trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged boundary along the trailing edge with medium-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; significantly more pronounced irregularities and ragged contours at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, sweeping upward towards the distal tips from the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely populated spatial clusters of white circular rings (barnacle scars) distributed across both lobes, with prominent groupings in the medial and lower-lateral sectors.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, multi-directional thin linear pixel disruptions (scratches/rake marks) concentrated primarily on the upper sections of the right lobe and center-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular erosion and physical fragmentation at the distal tips of both lobes; extensive coverage of circular barnacle attachment scars across the visible ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct, large circular white 'O' shaped mark located in the lower-medial quadrant of the left lobe.
